diagnosticPolicy: Earlier attempts record observations during dirty-source experiments, not source-bound qualifications. A diagnostic pass only means observations were collected. Only the final runner and Firefox regressions bind the final input hashes; no successful Safari qualification is claimed.
focusPolicy: Preserve Safari-specific visible focus rules. Focus-ring styling and :focus-visible, Tab navigation preferences, activeElement, document.hasFocus(), and trusted input delivery are separate observations. document.hasFocus() false alone establishes no defect. No Chrome-style focus ring or changed Safari preference is required.
retainedChanges: Wait for the actual fixture hydration entry point before invoking it; retain its original requestAnimationFrame readiness marker.
Require Safari document visibility before each scenario.
Record native click coordinates, target geometry, trusted-event paths and document focus without replacing native interactions.
discardedExperiments: Label typeahead, pacing, native select positive controls, extra window selection, element-click and script focus were diagnostic experiments; none is silently promoted as a Safari workaround. The final runner retains original End/Enter selection and coordinate pointer actions.
findings: The unchanged Safari runner and final diagnostic now have visible documents and pass four HTML consumer scenarios, unlike earlier hidden-window runs. No browser configuration was changed; cause of the environment change is unknown.
End/Enter leaves SVG selected in both a plain native select and the component select. Typeahead can choose PDF; closely spaced searches retain native state and an initial p can first select PNG.

Click traces after Tab show document.hasFocus false and no native click events, including with a following native text field. Later ordinary checkbox interactions also showed no click delivery and document.hasFocus false before any select action, so Tab is not established as the sole cause. The focus flag is supporting context; missing trusted input is the separate observation.
Standard owned-window selection, element-click, window.focus and control focus did not establish reliable document input. Element-click also produced a shadow-input interception error.
Native app inspection returned the normal Start Page after test cleanup and took unexpectedly long; it did not establish the automation window state.
remaining: Safari consumer qualification remains incomplete:55 planned scenarios were not run in the source-bound final acquisition.

Inspect the isolated Safari automation session with a paired native control to separate environment input delivery from component behavior and Safari-specific focus rules. Do not retry unchanged headlessly, alter browser security or synthesize clicks to make these assertions pass.
Safari full reference workflows, native AX/computed semantics, preceding Safari and manual/physical coverage remain unqualified.

buildReuse.policy: Existing qualified build reused unchanged; no production build, installation or type requalification claim.
